# Logistics 0.2.1-alpha.3

- The video player shows when it is preparing a different audio track and restores play or pause afterward. It handles files with unequal audio and video lengths, and late subtitle cues no longer extend the playable timeline.
- Open larger RMDOC notebooks on desktop and mobile. Large supported PDF notebooks can stream their pages on iOS and Android.
- The IDE honors project search exclusions and restores the workspace from a single saved state. Git keeps a conflict review tied to the branch it began on.
- Notes Library preserves its place when you switch between reading, file commands and playlists. Folder Hub can show saved results while it checks the current folder.
- The guides now start with common tasks and link to detailed reference material where you need it.

For a playback issue, include the device, OS, whether you used AirPlay, and the timestamp where the problem appeared.
